children: J.P. Morgan expects the Bank of England to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in February next year, following the central bank's decision to keep interest rates on hold but warned of tightening if the Iran war continued.
The brokerage previously expected the central bank to hike rates once in November 2026 and reduce rates twice in 2027.
